# tiny-tools

> Small, local-first MCP servers that let AI agents know things about files without reading them. Flagship: tiny-context (@tinytools/context) — outline, search, slice, SQL-query, diff and validate PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/CSV/logs. No telemetry, no network calls; every response is bounded and ends with a savings line.

Install (any MCP client, stdio): `npx -y -p @tinytools/context tiny-context-mcp`

## Docs
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools#readme): packages, install, benchmarks, honest comparison
- [tiny-context README](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/tree/main/packages/context#readme): the 8 tools, CLI, MCP config, hook
- [Agent usage snippet](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/packages/context/docs/AGENT_USAGE.md): 6 lines to paste into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/bench/RESULTS.md) and [comparison vs. a shell-capable agent](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/evals/COMPARISON.md)

## Tools (tiny-context)
file_map · query_file · read_section · query_table · summarize_log · diff_files · validate_file · extract
